name: canonical AI PM title
title: AI Product Manager
quote: "AI Product Manager": the title contains BOTH an AI word — ai, ... — AND a PM word — product manager / ...
note: lower-cased contains whole word 'ai' and 'product manager'.

name: PM phrase first, AI word after
title: Product Manager - Generative AI
quote: the title contains BOTH an AI word — ... generative ... — AND a PM word — product manager ...
note: order of the two words inside the title is irrelevant; match is 'anywhere in it'.

name: parenthesised AI
title: Technical Product Manager (AI)
quote: the title contains BOTH an AI word — ai ... — AND a PM word — product manager ...
note: parentheses are non-word chars so 'ai' is still a whole word.

name: ML + product owner
title: Machine Learning Product Owner
quote: an AI word — ... machine learning ... — AND a PM word — product owner ...
note: rule 1 must be checked before rule 2, which would also match 'machine learning'.

name: APM abbreviation with LLM
title: APM Intern - LLM Platform
quote: an AI word — ... llm ... — AND a PM word — ... apm ...
note: lower-casing turns 'APM' into 'apm'.

name: product lead + agentic
title: Product Lead, Agentic AI
quote: an AI word — ... agent, agents, agentic ... — AND a PM word — ... product lead ...
note: both 'agentic' and 'ai' are AI words; 'product lead' is a rule-1 PM word.

name: conversational AI PM
title: Conversational AI Product Manager
quote: an AI word — ... conversational — AND a PM word — product manager ...
note: 'conversational' alone would be rule 2, but rule 1 wins because it is checked first.

name: rule 1 must beat rule 2 when both apply
title: AI Agents — Associate Product Manager
quote: returns the FIRST track (in this order) whose pattern matches anywhere in it
note: 'ai'/'agents' would match rule 2, but 'associate product'/'product manager' plus an AI word makes rule 1 match, and rule 1 is first.

name: gen ai + product strategy
title: Gen AI Product Strategy Lead
quote: an AI word — ... genai, gen ai ... — AND a PM word — ... product strategy
note: 'gen ai' appears as two whole words.

name: dotted a.i. token
title: A.I. Product Manager
quote: an AI word — ai, a.i., artificial intelligence, ...
note: spec explicitly enumerates 'a.i.' as an AI word; title is lower-cased before matching.

name: product manag* prefix + ai/ml
title: Director of Product Management, AI/ML
quote: a PM word — product manager / product management / product managers (any word starting with "product manag") ...
note: 'product management' matches the 'product manag' prefix; 'ai' and 'ml' are whole words around the slash.

name: associate product but no AI word
title: Associate Product Manager
quote: "AI Product Manager": the title contains BOTH an AI word ... AND a PM word
note: rule 1 requires BOTH halves; there is no AI word here, so rule 1 cannot fire. Rule 5 matches 'associate product'/'product manager'.

name: PM intern without AI word
title: Product Manager Intern
quote: the title contains BOTH an AI word ... AND a PM word
note: near miss for rule 1: PM word present, AI word absent; falls through to rule 5 'product manager'.

name: bare product near miss
title: Retail Product Specialist
quote: "Product Manager": ... product designer, product intern, product.
note: must NOT be AI PM (no AI word). Bare 'product' only qualifies under rule 5.

name: AI + product but not a PM word
title: AI Product Engineer
quote: "AI Agentic Eng": ai, a.i., artificial intelligence, ...
note: near miss: rule 1 needs a PM word; 'product engineer' is not one of product manager/owner/apm/associate product/product lead/product intern/product strategy. Rule 2 matches 'ai'.

name: AI engineer intern
title: AI Engineer Intern
quote: "AI Agentic Eng": ai, a.i., artificial intelligence, ...
note: no PM word, so rule 1 is out; rule 2 matches 'ai'.

name: product designer with AI
title: Product Designer AI
quote: "AI Agentic Eng": ai, a.i., artificial intelligence, ...
note: near miss for rule 1: 'product designer' is a rule-5 PM word, not a rule-1 PM word, so rule 1 fails; rule 2 matches 'ai' first.

name: AI product analyst
title: AI Product Analyst
quote: "AI Agentic Eng": ai, a.i., artificial intelligence, ...
note: near miss: 'product analyst' is only a rule-5 PM word, not a rule-1 PM word; rule 2 matches 'ai' and precedes rule 5.

name: ai inside email
title: Email Marketing Intern
quote: Words are whole words (\b boundaries).
note: 'ai' inside 'email' is not a whole word; 'marketing intern' is not 'marketing analyst', so no rule matches.

name: ai inside mailroom
title: Mailroom Assistant
quote: Words are whole words (\b boundaries).
note: 'ai' inside 'mailroom' is not a whole word; no other pattern matches.

name: ai inside maintenance
title: Maintenance Planner
quote: Words are whole words (\b boundaries).
note: 'ai' inside 'maintenance' must not count as the AI word; nothing else matches, so the fallback applies: 'else "Other"'.

name: data engineer track
title: Data Engineer
quote: "Data Engineer": data engineer(ing), analytics engineer, ...
note: whole phrase match.

name: business intelligence to data analyst
title: Business Intelligence Analyst
quote: "Data Analyst": ... bi analyst, business intelligence, ...
note: 'business intelligence' matches rule 4.

name: data scien prefix
title: Data Scientist
quote: "Data Sci / Analytics": data scien…, data analy…, analytics, ...
note: 'data scientist' matches the 'data scien…' prefix in rule 6; rules 1-5 do not match.
